Hi Aisha / Liam —

Thanks for the quick demo request yesterday. To make the session valuable for your engineers + procurement/security, I'd like to align on attendees and propose a couple of 45-minute slots that include our SE and solutions lead. Goal: 30–35 minutes of discovery on your use case + 10–15 minute product tour focused on latency/cost controls and security posture.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45am
- Tue May 11, 2:00–2:45pm

If neither works, please suggest 2 other windows. I'll loop in Soojin (SE) and Alex (Solutions) after you confirm preferred time and any pre-read (architecture diagram, API volume expectations) we should review.

Attachments: mutual action plan (initial) attached for context.

Thanks,
Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Hey all —

2pm works for me. Quick answers to Soojin's questions:
- Peak QPS expected ~120 read requests, burst to ~350 for batch scoring during overnight windows.
- We do not plan on sharing PII; most payloads are semi-structured product telemetry.
- We run in AWS with VPC controls and would prefer a private deployment option for production.

Also: procurement asked if we could move the session by 1 hour later — they can be free at 3pm but not at 2. If possible, can we shift to 3:00–3:45pm PST so procurement can dial into the tail end? If that’s not feasible for Redwood, we’ll schedule a separate procurement-only slot Thu.

—Liam
Engineering Lead, NovaProd

- 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria (Marissa)
- 10–30m: Technical discovery (Liam + Soojin)
- 30–40m: Focused demo: routing, caching, private deployment options (Soojin)
- 40–45m: Procurement/security Q&A and next steps (Alex & Marissa)

Please accept the invite and let me know if access to any internal docs (security questionnaires, network diagrams) should be added to the shared drive ahead of time.
